from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyImpairment(BaseModel):
    """Asset impairment loss data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported")
    impairment_loss_amount: float | None = Field(description="Asset impairment loss amount as reported; negative values indicate negative impairment")
    impairment_loss_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label used for asset impairment loss in the report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this financial data")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the impairment loss value from the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    impairment_losses: list[CompanyImpairment]
